import pcbnew
board = pcbnew.GetBoard()
refs = [f"U{i}" for i in range(1, 9)]
for ref in refs:
    fp = board.FindFootprintByReference(ref)
    if fp:
        current = fp.GetOrientationDegrees()
        new_ori = (current - 90.0) % 360.0
        fp.SetOrientationDegrees(new_ori)
        print(f"{ref} rotated from {current}° to {new_ori}°")
pcbnew.UpdateUserInterface()
pcbnew.Refresh()
print("All LEDs rotated backward by 90 degrees.")
